title: Money-path code lacks tests where CONTRIBUTING.md requires them
steps: cd backend; jest --coverage limited to money-path files (unit and test:db configs).
expected: Every money-path module has tests exercising its main branches.
actual: Line coverage, unit / DB tests: directOrderExpiry 0% / 0% (expires unpaid orders and releases reserved stock), coupons 0% / 0%, commission 0% / 0%, wallet 36% / 0% (withdrawal of remaining balances), orders 53% / 0%. Well covered: directOrders 81% (DB), subscriptionPayments 88%, subscriptionBilling 91–100%, subscriptionsEtb 80%.
impact: Stock release on expiry and balance withdrawal — both handling buyers' and sellers' money or goods — can regress unnoticed.
fix: Add DB tests for directOrderExpiry (expire, release stock, idempotent re-run), wallet withdrawal (balance check, concurrency, 410 on retired routes), coupons validation; promote this audit's order-journey script to a test.
